Hi everyone. I'm Marko Herkaliuk, a PhD student at Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic
Institute. I work on neural solvers for the phonon Boltzmann transport equation.
I started using Lean to get the analytic parts of that work machine-checked rather
than argued on paper.

My first PR is https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/43535: six bounds comparing arctan x with x in
Trigonometric/Bounds.lean, mirroring the sin block already there. Comments welcome.

Hello, welcome! I took a quick look at the PR and I think the code is fine. I was almost driven away by the PR description, though, as this kind of format is noisy and often associated with AI-generated text (which is forbidden as PR message according to the guideline). If you take a look at merged PRs, most of them have short description that only calls out things that's not already obvious from the code. Likewise, local check result is not necessary in the message as the CI will say it.

Hi! Thank for that.
Let me update PR desc then. Should not take long
@Weiyi Wang should be better now. PTAL
